pillars.action: Refresh HEAD and Git object census; pin source identity.
pillars.label: Exact default-branch SHA observed
pillars.proof: Branch API/readback receipt and exact source SHA.
pillars.quality: Reject stale, partial and cross-head evidence.
pillars.threshold: Exactly one current default-branch 40-hex SHA per assessed repo; record timestamp and scope.

pillars.action: Deep-census source, docs, config, tests, binaries and orphan/zero-test files; classify disposition.
pillars.label: Root source and entrypoint located
pillars.proof: Content inventory with owner, path, blob OID and applicability.
pillars.quality: No ghost, untracked, empty or duplicate assets; provenance for source population.
pillars.threshold: Document at least one canonical entrypoint, README, source inventory and applicable test/asset populations; enumerate zero and missing buckets.

pillars.action: Approve source authority, acceptance criteria, completeness and semantic-quality defects.
pillars.label: Release applicability and owner signed
pillars.proof: Signed scope and validated content-quality receipt per repo.
pillars.quality: Schema, semantic links, freshness and provenance checked; unknown remains unknown.
pillars.threshold: Scope and release applicability explicitly owned; required content attributes filled or classified as not applicable.

pillars.action: Run independent clean checkout/build, dependency audit, formatters and deterministic replay.
pillars.label: Reproducible dependency/build contract qualified
pillars.proof: Terminal build jobs, pinned inputs, artifact hash comparison.
pillars.quality: YAML/JSON/TOML/INIT validation, lint/format parity, reproducible output digests.
pillars.threshold: Reproducible build from pinned dependency and toolchain contracts with zero build/parse failures.

pillars.action: Repair native first-red, add tests for untested code; count statement/branch/asset populations.
pillars.label: Native primary B0/test equivalent terminal PASS
pillars.proof: Exact-head primary test report, zero-test registry and first-red receipt.
pillars.quality: Pass/fail/skip denominators and first-red signatures captured, not suppressed.
pillars.threshold: Native mandatory primary B0/job terminal success at exact head; zero untested critical entrypoints.

pillars.action: Run cross-module smoke, deployment dry-run, negative paths and recovery tests.
pillars.label: Independent domain/integration smoke terminal PASS
pillars.proof: Exact-head independent smoke run with job, logs and service identity.
pillars.quality: Exercise API/CLI/data flows, failure injection, rollback/restart and boundary contracts.
pillars.threshold: At least one owner-designated independent integration/startup/smoke proof for each applicable deployed runtime.

pillars.action: Qualify CodeQL languages, supply chain, dependency and vulnerability scans with first-red lineage.
pillars.label: Security and supply-chain gates accepted
pillars.proof: Source-bound scan-completion jobs, severity ledger and accepted disposition.
pillars.quality: High-risk findings and exemptions independently reviewed; neutral CodeQL alone not positive scan proof.
pillars.threshold: No undispositioned blocking security findings; pinned supply-chain inputs and approved scanner identities.

pillars.action: Activate enforceable branch rules and run failing unmerged canary after policy change.
pillars.label: Effective protection and rejected RED canary
pillars.proof: Effective ruleset readback and rejected RED-canary PR receipt.
pillars.quality: Fetch effective rules and check integration IDs; negative merge proof required.
pillars.threshold: Effective required GoGREEN and applicable CodeQL contexts plus blocked RED canary; no force-push/deletion.

pillars.action: Capture eligible review or signed waiver receipts; reject stale/other-head reviews.
pillars.label: Eligible independent human approval
pillars.proof: Reviewer identity, exact commit, review disposition and waiver scope if applicable.
pillars.quality: WAIVED_MACH_II cannot replace required checks; matching automated review and policy evidence needed.
pillars.threshold: Eligible head-matched human review; alternatively an explicitly authorized narrow solo-owner waiver.

pillars.action: Reduce zero-tested critical assets, expand branch and negative-path tests, compare matched denominators.
pillars.label: Matched coverage and negative tests accepted
pillars.proof: Scoped statement/branch reports with denominator, instrumentor and negative-path proof.
pillars.quality: Critical zero-covered modules, untested branches and mutation/negative paths tracked separately.
pillars.threshold: Matched-scope coverage floor signed per repo; hub JADE pilot currently 90% statements/80% branches.

pillars.action: Build central cockpit, KPI/BD/discovery views; hash-stage with single publisher; verify hosted GET parity.
pillars.label: Source-bound binary/site artifact QA and hashes
pillars.proof: Artifact manifest, responsive screenshots, URLs, HTTP 200, matching bytes and browser receipt.
pillars.quality: Separate authored, built, staged, deployed, hosted-HTTP, served-SHA and browser-qualified states.
pillars.threshold: Generated user views must pass 1440x1000, 1280x800, 390x844 QA, zero broken links/errors, complete source+artifact hashes.

pillars.action: Exercise deploy/rollback/runbook, verify operational logs/alerts, capture owner release decision.
pillars.label: Owner point-release tag, assets and rollback signed
pillars.proof: Tag, deploy/run/health/rollback receipts and explicit owner ACCEPT/HOLD.
pillars.quality: No release credit from a static page or green CI; applicability and operational limits signed.
pillars.threshold: Owner-signed tag, manifest and rollback; independently proven runtime startup, health and recovery where applicable.

publication.note: No hosted, deployment, operational or owner-release proof is inferred from source code.
